content:
Alex: FYI I opened PR to bump the API contract for a small streaming header change. SDK + console need quick tweaks. PRs: api: https://github.com/redwood/inference-api/pull/482, sdk-js: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/215, console: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1390. Trying to land before Thursday deploy window. Need one more approval on SDK and a helm chart bump to pick up the new runtime image.
Priya: linked. what's the compatibility risk? Can older SDKs still call the new API without a code change?
Alex: Should be backward compatible for non-streaming calls. The streaming behavior flips when header `x-rw-stream-keys` is present; SDK needs to map the streaming option to that header. Console only needs a small toggle. Runtime image update means helm values need `runtime.imageTag: v2.7.0`.
Tom: I can review the SDK tonight. @Marta can you look at the console UI? Also Helm charts live in infra/helm-charts — I can open the chart PR if you want.
Marta: on it, can do a quick pass. Any test harness or sample request I can run locally?
Alex: yes — sample curl is in the API PR description. Paste here for quick run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'x-rw-stream-keys: 1' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Priya: SDK PR looks small. main thing: add header mapping and a unit test. left one comment about error mapping.
Tom: left a couple tiny comments, nothing blocking. @Alex if you rebase I'll approve.
Alex: rebased and pushed. +1 from @Tom would be great before I merge so infra PR can include the chart bump in the same release.
ci-bot: SDK build passed (linux, mac). integration tests: 12/13 passed — failing test is flaky `test-chat-stream`. re-running.
ci-bot: integration rerun passed. all green.
Marta: console tweaks ready, filed console PR. I also added a small e2e step to toggle streaming in the smoke tests.
Priya: approving SDK now. @Alex merge when ready; please coordinate with @Leo (infra-sre) for helm rollout to staging first.
Alex: merging now. I'll open infra PR for helm values (https://github.com/redwood/infra/helm-charts/pull/77) and ping infra-sre. Can we aim for staging deploy today and prod tomorrow during low traffic window? :calendar:
Leo: got the ping. Staging today 4pm PT ok. Prod tomorrow 2am PT preferred. I'll set up a canary at 10% for the first 30m and rollback hooks.
Alex: perfect. tagging this thread for tracking, thanks all :tada:
